notes: Claude now reads far less at the start of a session. The board's plain-text summary (.tracker/DEFERRED.md) used to hold the full text of every card, finished and cut ones included, so it only ever grew. It is now a short list: one line a card with its number, finished and cut cards by title only, and the start of each open card's write-up. Claude reads a single card in full when it needs one. Nothing is removed from your board, and existing projects switch over by themselves the next time their board is open.
